headline: Nevish Line Rekindles as Weathered Expanse Surges Anew
war_summary: Three hours on have reshuffled the wires. Nevish Line has rekindled to eight changes in two hours and twenty-seven on the day about Blackcoat Way, Tomb Father and Grief Mother, standing seven Warden to one Colonial, while Weathered Expanse has surged to ten in two hours and forty-one on the day about Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, now three Warden, four Colonial and two neutral. Marban Hollow has likewise stirred to three in two hours and twenty on the day about Oster Wall and Checkpoint Bua, even at three aside with two neutral, the latest wire timed to the cutoff. Gutter, busiest on the day with fifty-seven changes about Kuoppa, Salaoja Road and The Parras at five Warden and two neutral, has cooled to two in two hours. Palantine Berm, with twenty-two on the day about Vendett and Underlook at one to six, records nothing in the last two hours, as does Linn Mercy with five on the day, while Godcrofts shows one in two hours. Callahan's Passage still carries the heaviest daily toll above eleven thousand Colonial and eight thousand Warden casualties with Stonecradle above two thousand each, neither with a recorded change.
